subject: science
passage: Members of the fish species Astyanax mexicanus that live in pitch-dark caves in Mexico have greatly reduced eyes or none at all, while members of the same species living in surface rivers have normal eyes. Because the eye and the brain tissue used for vision consume a great deal of energy, biologists have proposed that eyes become a costly burden in total darkness, where they provide no benefit. Biologist Rocío Altamirano compared cave fish from two caves that are equally dark: one receives regular floods that wash in plant debris and insects, while the other receives almost no food from outside. Fish from the food-poor cave had even smaller eyes. If the biologists' proposal is correct, this difference suggests that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: the cost of maintaining eyes may weigh more heavily on fish where food is scarce.
choices.B: fish in the flood-fed cave use their eyes to find the food that the floods bring in.
choices.C: the fish in the two caves are descended from two different surface populations.
choices.D: fish in the flood-fed cave will eventually regain fully working eyes.

explanation.why: The proposal says eyes are a burden in the dark because they use energy and give nothing back. Where food, and so energy, is scarcer, that cost should matter more. The fish in the food-poor cave have the smallest eyes, which fits the idea that the energy cost of eyes is felt most where food is scarce.
explanation.A: Correct. If eyes are a burden because they use energy, that burden should be heaviest where energy from food is hardest to get, matching the smaller eyes in the food-poor cave.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Both caves are equally and completely dark, so eyes would give no benefit in either one, including for finding food.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The text says nothing about the ancestry of the two cave populations.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text compares eye size in two caves; it gives no basis for predicting that any cave fish will regain working eyes.
